title: Missed Cross-Sell Opportunity (Second Vehicle)
description: Customer casually mentions spouse's vehicle during insurance quotation.

chunks.speaker: Agent
chunks.text: Alright Mr. Henderson, I have your 2022 Ford F-150 quoted at $142 a month.

chunks.speaker: Customer
chunks.text: That looks pretty good. Yeah, my wife has a 2023 Honda CR-V that might need insurance next month too.

chunks.speaker: Agent
chunks.text: Great, let's proceed with finalizing your Ford truck policy first.
